notes: An unnamed source mentioned AI. Stone's own statement gave a different level of detail.

speaker: Kenny Rose, founder
supporting_paraphrase: Rose attributed the shutdown to insufficient capital and marketplace challenges.

speaker: Crypto.com spokesperson
supporting_paraphrase: The company linked the reduction to an enterprise-wide AI rollout, a shift in resources and efficiency goals.
notes: The statement identifies no task taken over by AI.

speaker: Snowflake spokesperson
supporting_paraphrase: The spokesperson described targeted adjustments to align teams with the company's long-term strategy as it grew.
notes: Earlier comments about AI products did not identify the reason for this round.

speaker: Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, shareholder letter

speaker: Spotify spokesperson
supporting_paraphrase: The spokesperson declined to discuss staffing changes.
notes: An unnamed source described a shift toward video. Management attribution was unavailable.

speaker: Tim Sweeney, CEO
supporting_paraphrase: Sweeney attributed the cuts to lower Fortnite engagement and spending beyond revenue. He explicitly ruled out AI as the cause.

speaker: OpenText spokesperson
supporting_paraphrase: OpenText confirmed the cuts and described aligning its organization with customer needs, strategic priorities and long-term growth.
notes: The spokesperson gave a broad strategic reason for this round.

speaker: Barr Moses, CEO
supporting_paraphrase: Moses linked the restructuring to smaller AI-enabled teams and described support staff resolving issues that previously required escalation.
notes: She also described product investment and fewer management layers.

speaker: Quandoo, closure announcement
supporting_paraphrase: Quandoo announced a planned wind-down of all operations, with the platform and bookings phased out over several months.
notes: The company's notice is dated March 24. The tracker records March 26.

speaker: Enpal, company explanation
supporting_paraphrase: Enpal described replacing separate service contacts with a personal adviser covering the full customer journey and dissolving the previous service unit.
notes: The March 24 report describes the same 97-person service unit as the March 27 tracker source.

speaker: Ankit Kamra, cofounder and CEO
supporting_paraphrase: Kamra attributed the closure to a prolonged shortage of cash.

speaker: Monzo, company statement
supporting_paraphrase: Monzo said it would close its U.S. operation and concentrate on the UK and Europe.
notes: The company headquarters and the affected operation are in different countries.

speaker: Oracle, employee notification
supporting_paraphrase: The notice described a broader organizational change without identifying what drove it.
notes: Coverage discussed AI spending. The March notice did not attribute the round to AI or explain the underlying change.

speaker: Rec Room, closure announcement
supporting_paraphrase: Rec Room said costs exceeded revenue and changes in the VR and gaming markets made profitability unattainable.
notes: The company announced the wind-down March 30. The tracker records March 31.

speaker: Yupp founders, including CEO Pankaj Gupta
supporting_paraphrase: The founders linked closure to weak demand for their evaluation product as model capabilities rapidly improved.
notes: The AI connection concerns the market for the product.
